summary: Tahoe NF lookout in Sierra County: built 1929 on Bald Mountain as Babbit Lookout in a Dunce Cap cab design; staffed in 2011; NHLR-registered 2003.

facts.design: Dunce Cap cab, California region design with a steep roof pitch developed in 1923

visit.trail_note: Three routes to a final six-mile leg (2011 register visit); two-wheel drive with medium clearance is enough. A gate about half a mile from the tower may be closed; then park about three quarters of a mile away.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 1929 and 1965 newspaper items call it Babbit, after a pioneer ranger. Newspaper items from 1930 to 1960 and the FFLA list use Babbitt. The record name follows the register; the spelling difference is not an error in the record.

The 1928 and 1929 newspaper items place the new station on Bald Mountain. The register names the site Babbit Peak, with coordinates close to the FFLA list. No source states outright that these are the same summit. A 1944 item calls the station Babbitt Lookout on Bald Mountain, and a 1930 item calls the lookout Babbitt Peak.

notes_for_editor: The name in the record, Babbit Peak Lookout, matches the register, so no name correction is proposed; the 1929 and 1965 items use Babbit and the 1930 to 1960 items use Babbitt. The record has no built year; the 1929 newspapers support 1929 as the build year (construction was announced for July 1929 and the building was in use by late August). That is recorded as an event, not a correction. The 1928 and 1929 papers place the station on Bald Mountain. Identity with the register's Babbit Peak is inferred, not stated, and should get a human look. The newest staffing record is the 2011 register visit; the 2007 and 2009 FFLA reports describe staffed use but not current status. A web search turned up a 2025 Sierraville Ranger District page that does not mention Babbitt Peak; search snippets were not read, so nothing from them is cited. The FFLA list agrees with the record: Encl. Tower, Standing, NHLR US 515, CA 53. Access level is not stated in any source read; left out. No new photos were added.
